title: WORLD CLEANUP DAY 2026: DRIVING A GREENER VIETNAM WITH OUR PARTNERS
summary: The biggest environmental event of the year, World Cleanup Day 2026, is officially here! Creating a clean environment takes team effort, and we are proud to work alongside our amazing corporate partners who share our dream of a greener Vietnam.

contentBlocks.value: The biggest environmental event of the year, World Cleanup Day 2026, is officially here! Creating a clean environment takes team effort, and we are proud to work alongside our amazing corporate partners who share our dream of a greener Vietnam.

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to our Diamond Sponsors, Unilever Vietnam and Honda Vietnam, together with our Gold Sponsor, Easia Travel, for their steadfast support. Our mission is further empowered by our incredible Silver Sponsors, Hirdaramani Vietnam – Fashion Garments Limited Vietnam, Hilton Garden Inn Hanoi, all standing together for a greener future.

Organized by World Cleanup Day together with Let’s Do It Hanoi and Let’s Do It Vietnam, the event will take place on Saturday, September 19, 2026 at Pham Hung Street, Nam Tu Liem, Hanoi. Expanding our impact nationwide, World Cleanup Day will also run concurrently on September 19 and 20 in major cities like Can Tho, Ho Chi Minh City, Hai Phong, Da Nang, and various local provinces.
